firstScreen.notes: 1440-first.jpg: 'Find it. Fix it. Tag it.' is clear, trade+city in kicker. Phone visible in header. 390-first.jpg: Headline stacks well, buttons above fold.

distinctiveness.notes: 1440-full.jpg: Pipe rail and brass tag concept is structurally present (CSS classes verified). Green accent band breaks the pattern. Signature needs more visual weight with real media to fully land.

type.notes: dist/index.html: Zilla Slab + Karla + DM Mono is a strong, distinct pairing. Hierarchy is clear in 1440-first.jpg.

layout.notes: 1440-full.jpg: Good tone alternation (Light/Deep/Accent). Dark sections feel empty due to placeholders, creating voids in the rhythm. Process section likely repetitive.

photo.notes: 1440-full.jpg: All media is placeholder. Consistent aspect ratios, but no grade or art direction visible. No video element for cinematic strip.

copy.notes: 1440-first.jpg: 'Find it. Fix it. Tag it.' is excellent. Specific trade nouns used. Microcopy is helpful.

mobile.notes: 390-first.jpg: Composed layout, not squeezed. Tap targets look good. Sticky bar present.

a11y.notes: dist/index.html: Skip link, focus outlines, semantic HTML, reduced motion CSS, ARIA labels all present.

motion.notes: dist/index.html: CSS infrastructure for reveals is robust. Cannot verify the quality of the 'swing' or 'fill' animations without interaction, but hooks are present.

wow.notes: 1440-full.jpg: ZIP checker is functional. Tool outputs (Shut-off finder) appear to be standard text/form interactions rather than designed artifacts (SVG/Printable).

polish.notes: dist/index.html: Favicon, OG tags, JSON-LD present. Credits list is repetitive (12 identical lines).

elevate.move: Even with placeholders, add texture or a subtle duotone pattern to the deep navy sections so they don't read as empty voids, giving the pipe rail a physical space to run through.
Make the brass tag signature interactive or animated (e.g., a stamp effect) in the footer or process section to reinforce the 'Tag it' promise and create a memorable moment.
